rounds.question: Name a problem Progressives tried to fix in the early 1900s

answers.explanation: This is a Progressive Era problem — Upton Sinclair's The Jungle exposed the meatpacking industry, leading to the Pure Food and Drug Act.
This is a Progressive Era problem — TR's trust-busting broke up Standard Oil and other monopolies that stifled competition.
This is a Progressive Era problem — millions of children worked dangerous jobs; reformers campaigned for laws to protect them.
This is a Progressive Era problem — urban political machines like Tammany Hall used patronage and bribery to dominate city government.
This is a Progressive Era problem — the Triangle Shirtwaist Fire (1911) galvanized public support for workplace safety laws.

rounds.question: Name a muckraker and what they exposed

answers.text: Upton Sinclair exposed the meatpacking industry
answers.explanation: This is a muckraker — Sinclair's The Jungle described unsanitary conditions so vividly it forced passage of the Meat Inspection Act.
This is a muckraker — Tarbell's investigation of Rockefeller's monopoly helped build the case for breaking up Standard Oil.
This is a muckraker — Riis's photographs in How the Other Half Lives shocked middle-class Americans with images of slum life.
This is a muckraker — Steffens documented city machine corruption in The Shame of the Cities.

answers.explanation: This is a Progressive Era reform — it banned adulterated food and false labeling, the direct result of Sinclair's muckraking.
This is a Progressive Era reform — TR used the Sherman Act aggressively to break up monopolies in ways it had never been used before.

rounds.question: Name something associated with American imperialism in the early 1900s

answers.explanation: This is associated with American imperialism — the 1898 war gave the US control of Cuba, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the Philippines.

answers.explanation: This is associated with American imperialism — these territories were ceded by Spain after the Spanish-American War.
This is associated with American imperialism — TR helped engineer Panama's independence from Colombia to secure the canal route.

answers.text: United States as a world power
answers.explanation: This is associated with American imperialism — the Spanish-American War signaled the US had joined Britain and Germany as a global power.

answers.explanation: This is a Progressive reform method — exposés by Sinclair, Tarbell, and Riis created the public pressure that drove legislation.

rounds.question: Name a goal of the women's suffrage movement

answers.explanation: This is a goal of the women's suffrage movement — the central demand was the 19th Amendment, finally ratified in 1920.
This is a goal of the women's suffrage movement — suffragists argued voting was the foundation of equal citizenship.
This is a goal of the women's suffrage movement — reformers like Elizabeth Cady Stanton connected voting rights to professional equality.
This is a goal of the women's suffrage movement — the movement argued women deserved equal rights in all areas of public life.
This is a goal of the women's suffrage movement — without the vote, women had no way to hold elected officials accountable.
